info.name: Conference Registration API - Conformance Suite
info.description: Black-box tests for any implementation of the Conference Registration spec. One top-level folder per version (v1-v4). Run a single version with `newman run ... --folder "v1 - Buy a ticket"`. Generated by postman/build_collection.py from openapi.yaml.

item.name: v1 - Buy a ticket
Reset (NFR-8)
Reset to an empty database with sample configuration

request.description: Every run starts from the sample properties file and an empty database. Test support must be switched on, otherwise this returns 404 and the whole run is invalid.

item.name: AC-03 / FR-2.4: Attendee emails must be unique within an order
AC-03: two tickets with the same attendee email are rejected

request.description:
**Given** a cart with 2 tickets

**When** both attendees are given the same email

**Then** the order is rejected with a duplicate-email error

item.name: FR-2.4: the same email may hold a ticket in a different order

request.description:
**Given** pat.buyer@example.com already holds a General ticket from AC-01

**When** another order buys an Early Bird ticket for the same email

**Then** the order succeeds, because uniqueness is per order only

exec: pm.test("Ticket issued to an email already used in AC-01", () =>

item.name: AC-04: Declined card places no order
AC-04: card ending 0002 is declined

request.description:
**Given** a valid cart of 1 Student ticket

**When** the buyer pays with card 4000 0000 0000 0002

**Then** no order or tickets are created. The Student count is verified later in AC-05, which only works out if this order left no ticket behind.

item.name: AC-04: the buyer retries the same cart with another card

request.description:
**Given** the previous order was declined

**When** the buyer retries with card 5555 5555 5555 4444

**Then** the order succeeds. This is the first Student ticket sold (1 of 55).

exec: pm.test("Order is paid at 99.00 with the second card", () => {

item.name: Request validation (FR-2.1, FR-4.1)
FR-2.1: 11 tickets exceeds the order maximum of 10

request.description:
**Given** the order maximum is 10 tickets

**When** a buyer submits 11 Student tickets

**Then** the order is rejected with order_too_large and nothing is sold

item.name: FR-4.1: a card number that fails the Luhn check is rejected

request.description:
**Given** a valid cart of 1 Student ticket

**When** the card number 4242 4242 4242 4241 fails Luhn

**Then** the order is rejected with validation_failed on /payment/number and nothing is sold

item.description: Spec section 11, version v1: GET /event, GET /ticket-types, POST /orders, POST /test/reset. Covers AC-01 and AC-02 (without email checks), AC-03 to AC-05, AC-07 and the API part of AC-22. AC-06 (concurrent orders) is not included yet. Requests depend on the ones before them, so run the folder in order.
